boxes.arrange.atShape: at of arrange is {"x": integer, "y": integer} (the cell for the top left of the arrangement)
boxes.arrange.columns: columns of arrange is a whole number from 1 to 12 (not {v})
boxes.arrange.shape: arrange is {"cards": [paths…] or "region": {…}, "columns": number of columns, "at": {"x", "y"}}
boxes.move.byOrTo: Give either by (the cells to shift by) or to (the cell for the top left) for move
boxes.move.byShape: by of move is {"x": integer, "y": integer} (the cells to shift by; may be negative)
boxes.move.toShape: to of move is {"x": integer, "y": integer} (the cell for the top left of the chosen boxes)
boxes.only.strayKeys: {what} has keys that are not accepted: {stray}. Accepted: {keys} (the shape is in guide with about: {what})
boxes.picked.cardsShape: cards of {what} is a list of paths of cards (card ghosts too) or of sections to be section ghosts
boxes.picked.cardsStrings: cards of {what} is a list of path strings (not {raw})
boxes.picked.emptyRegion: No box falls in the region of {what}
boxes.picked.notPlaced: {what} "{path}" is not placed in this section's diagram
boxes.picked.oneOf: Give either cards (a list of paths) or region for {what}
boxes.places.ghostSize: places "{path}": a card ghost is drawn at the size of the card it points to (size cannot be given)
boxes.places.notPlaced: places "{path}" is not placed yet, so give topLeft too
boxes.places.sectionGhost: places "{path}": only another section that appears in this section's diagram can become a section ghost
boxes.places.shape: places is {topLeft, size} for each path (e.g. {"Core:User": {"topLeft": {"x": 0, "y": 0}}})
boxes.places.strayKeys: places "{path}" has keys that are not accepted: {keys}. Accepted: topLeft / size
boxes.region.shape: region is {"from": {"x": integer, "y": integer}, "to": {"x": integer, "y": integer}, "mode": "intersect" | "contain"} (cells; from and to may be any two corners and both cells are included; mode is intersect (boxes with any part inside; the default) or contain (boxes entirely inside))
boxes.region.strayKeys: region has keys that are not accepted: {keys}. {shape}
